localFailures.error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir 'C:\Users\ttt45\Workspace\personal\passport\release\checks\20261002T133725Z-f4497cc-win-x64-local-release\nsis\$PLUGINSDIR'

changes: Windows Bash first input byte after resize is preserved using per-session prompt/command markers. The primer stays out of child CLI input; regression checks 30 resizes and exact child input bytes, including an unrelated standard OSC prompt marker.
ConPTY device/focus reports remain forwarded, but are excluded from the paste fixture user-input count. Shell tests expect escaped display and still execute paths to verify exact content.
Mixed workspace fixture uses the actual keyboard path, interactive prompt and execution marker; notification, ownership and restore assertions remain.

Hidden Windows E2E rendering flags and one Windows unit worker are in shared tests. Minimal 7za direct NSIS app extraction is supported without dropping payload checks. Windows ASAR reads use native separators and packaged GUI launches receive the same hidden rendering/screenshot switches that Playwright injects for source launches.
Initial win-x64 1.1.1 publication requires a matching Windows source tag, the original Mac tag/asset and an allowlisted source diff. All original verification/evidence gates remain.

Backported microsoft/node-pty#922 to pinned 1.1.0; exact native source hashes are checked, source compilation is forced, and the fixed module is copied to every loader fallback for this architecture. Existing normal shutdown assertions remain.

diagnostics.conptyUpgrade: Official stable 1.24 ConPTY comparison also reproduced the bug; original dependency restored before formal npm ci.

limitations: Physical IME, OS notifications, real AI services, upgrade installation, and optional Docker/long stress tests are separate checks.
Windows installer UI/scope and extracted payload are checked; installing/uninstalling into a user account is a separate check.

Repeated reconnection diagnostics can leave Bash/OpenConsole descendants after the launcher exits. Isolated leftovers were identity-checked and cleaned; normal app exit is not proof that every descendant lifetime path is resolved.

cleanupCandidates.scope: Resolved input, ASAR, hidden rendering and native crash diagnostics plus failed rehearsals, after retaining the latest two successful builds.
cleanupCandidates.exclude: Published installer, checksums, unresolved descendant lifetime reproduction, KEEP-marked folders, active processes and recovery tools.
